column1: # C# NepaliDateRange.SplitByMonth and SplitByFiscalQuarter (NR22, NR23). The first and
# last piece are clipped to the range ends; a piece is written start..end. C# advances to
# the next month or quarter after the last piece and throws
# ArgumentOutOfRangeException when that would pass 2199-12-30. The D-16 rows hold the
# port's value: every piece, the last one ending at the range end.
